forbidden.comment: Models are imported by every other layer of an app; a model that imports a view, form, admin, serializer or URL configuration makes that a cycle and loads the web layer with the ORM. plan:rulebearing-django
forbidden.fix: Move the logic the model needs into the model or a service module that both sides import, or connect it with a signal in the app's apps.py ready().
forbidden.name: django-models-are-innermost

forbidden.comment: A view is an entry Django reaches through a URL configuration; any other module that imports one ties itself to the request cycle. plan:rulebearing-django
forbidden.fix: Move the shared logic out of the view into a service or a model method and import that; reverse() a URL name instead of importing the view.
forbidden.name: django-views-only-from-urls

forbidden.comment: A migration is a frozen snapshot Django runs in order; code that imports one breaks when the migration is squashed or renamed. plan:rulebearing-django
forbidden.fix: Import the model or the function from the app itself; a data migration that needs shared code imports it from the app, not the other way round.
forbidden.name: django-no-import-of-migrations
